text:
anna-ml: Quick readiness check for icy13b onboarding — weights are uploaded but smoke run showed a tokenizer oddity. Can someone confirm the canonical weights path + any serving flags we should flip before canary?

joel-infra: weights live at s3://redwood-models/icy13b/v1/icy13b-weights.tar.gz. checksum sha256: d4c3b2a1f9e8c7b6a5e4d3c2b1a0f9876543210fedcba0987654321abcdef1234. I'll bind-mount under /mnt/models/icy13b on the canary hosts.

sam-serving: FYI the model.yaml we've been using needs two non-defaults for our runtime: `use_bos: false` and `pad_token_id: 0`. Also recommend `max_batch_size: 12` and `batch_timeout_ms: 15` to avoid long tail latency.

maya-ml: ran a small perf sweep on devbox (A100-80GB). Command I used:
```
python -m rw_bench --model /mnt/models/icy13b --batch 8 --seq 512 --warmup 10 --iters 100
```
Summary: p50 ~78ms/token, p95 ~210ms/token for steady-state. However saw 1-2 spikes ~2.2s at the start of some sequences. Logs show repeated BOS tokens emitted by tokenizer on certain prompts which causes kv cache reinit.

joel-infra: can you paste a tiny repro snippet of the tokenization that shows the repeated BOS? Might be an export edge.

maya-ml: minimal repro (python):
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode(' Hello world').tokens)  # -> ['<bos>', '<bos>', 'Hello', 'world']
```
So there's an extra leading BOS if the input starts with a space. I added a quick preproc to strip leading spaces and re-ran, spikes disappeared.

sam-serving: Good find. For the canary please enable our tokenizer shim via env `TOKENIZER_PREP=strip_leading_space` (temporary) and set `REDWOOD_MAX_BATCH=12` and `REDWOOD_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=15`. Also enable `PREFILL_KV_CACHE=true` for generation workloads.

buildkite-bot: PR #3421 (icy13b model.yaml + tokenizer shim) — config-lint: PASS :white_check_mark:, unit token-tests: 48/48 passed.

anna-ml: ok I'll spin the canary in ~10m and run a 30m perf sweep across batch sizes [1,4,8,12]. Please keep alerts on for any latency > 500ms end-to-end. I'll post a summary in this thread.

maya-ml: I'll add a tiny unit check that runs `tokenizer.encode` against our whitespace edgecases and gate it in the model repo. Saves a lot of head-scratching later.

sam-serving: ping me when canary is up and I'll tail `serving.log` for `kv_cache_miss` and `tokenizer_rewind` events. Also tagging @joel-infra for mount perf monitoring.

joel-infra: mount is ready on canary hosts, mapped size ~16GB, permissions and SELinux labels ok. I enabled async prefetch for s3 reads for the weights.

anna-ml: TY everyone :thumbsup: — if you see anything urgent DM me. I'll attach the perf CSV and notes once the sweep finishes.

maya-ml: :eyes: leaving a quick note to run an additional sweep with `seq 1024` after the initial run — tokenizer patterns change on long prompts.

sam-serving: noted. I'll add a quick dashboard card for Batch vs Latency and a canary alert if batch p95 > 400ms.

anna-ml: perfect, talk soon.
